_comment: X = Draconic chain links you control, counted from ChainLink.talents via COUNT_CHAIN_LINKS. Both payoff halves re-filtered the WHOLE banished zone instead of acting on the card just banished, so with two eligible cards sitting there it could pump one and unlock a different one -- and neither reached the game state anyway: MODIFY_ATTACK reads no target, and SET_FLAG appends a STRING to current_turn_effects that nothing looks at, while play.py consults player.playable_from_banished. The cost bound is "LESS THAN", not "or equal to"; CARD_COST_LT is the strict form. "You may banish" is optional, and "if you do" means the payoff must not fire when nothing was banished.
